description: NP chunk extraction edge cases: DET in non-first position, multiple DET tokens, ADJ-led NP span.
notes: Wave 2 closes three C05 gaps: (1) DET in non-first position was untested; (2) multiple DET tokens were untested; (3) ADJ-led NP spans were not verified. No implementation changes — all gaps were gold/test coverage gaps. DET is not in STOP_POS so it never breaks the segment, but _is_valid_np_span rejects any span where DET is at a non-first position (DET not in CORE_NP_POS or MODIFIER_POS). ADJ is in MODIFIER_POS, so it is allowed as the first token of a span (MODIFIER_POS opens segments).

cases.description: DET in non-first position — spans containing DET at non-first position are rejected; sub-span starting AT the DET is valid
cases.notes: DET at index 1 (non-first) is not in STOP_POS → stays in segment. [ספר,ה]=NOUN+DET: DET non-first → rejected by _is_valid_np_span. [ספר,ה,ילד]=NOUN+DET+NOUN: DET non-first → rejected. [ה,ילד]=DET+NOUN: DET first → valid, has CORE_NP (ילד) → valid; merge_standalone_articles merges 'ה'+'ילד' → 'הילד'. Contract: DET in non-first position → span rejected (by design). Sub-span starting at DET → valid.

cases.description: Multiple standalone DET tokens — second DET blocks all bridge spans; only first DET+NOUN bigram is extracted
cases.notes: None of the 4 tokens are in STOP_POS → single segment. [ה,ילד]=DET+NOUN: valid → 'הילד'. [ילד,ה]=NOUN+DET(non-first)→ rejected. [ה,גדול]=DET+ADJ: no CORE_NP (ADJ is MODIFIER only) → rejected. All n=3 and n=4 spans contain second ה at non-first position → rejected. Contract: second DET prevents any span from bridging across it; only the first [DET,NOUN] bigram survives.

cases.description: ADJ-led NP span — MODIFIER_POS (ADJ) can open a segment; produces 3 chunks
cases.notes: ADJ is in MODIFIER_POS; is_valid_np_token(ADJ, is_first=True) → True. [ישן,בית]=ADJ+NOUN: ADJ first → valid, has CORE_NP → valid. [בית,ספר]=NOUN+NOUN → valid. [ישן,בית,ספר]=ADJ+NOUN+NOUN → valid. Contract: ADJ (MODIFIER_POS) is explicitly allowed as first token by is_valid_np_token — no DET prefix required to open a segment.
